description: Calls to the Segment HTTP Tracking API, single or batched under `batch`.

params.name: writeKey
params.description: It identifies the source the data lands in. Segment also accepts it as HTTP basic auth, so it is not required in the body.
params.fix_hint: Send the source write key in the body or as the basic auth username.

params.name: batch
params.description: The vendor documents `batch` in the request contract.

params.name: batch[]
params.description: The vendor documents `batch[]` in the request contract.
The vendor documents `` in the request contract.

params.name: type
params.description: Segment documents that each call in a batch must carry a `type` naming a valid method.
params.fix_hint: Set `type` to one of identify, track, page, screen, group, or alias.

params.name: event
params.description: It is the name of the action the user performed, and Segment documents it as required on a track call.
params.fix_hint: Name the event, such as `Item Purchased`.

params.name: groupId
params.description: It identifies the group. Segment documents it as required on a group call.
params.fix_hint: Set `groupId` to the group in your database.

params.name: previousId
params.description: It is the previous unique identifier. Segment documents it as required on an alias call.
params.fix_hint: Set `previousId` to the id being merged.

rules.message: A `track` call carries no `event`. Segment documents the event name as required, and drops the call without it.
rules.fix_hint: Add the event name to the call.

rules.message: A `group` call carries no `groupId`. Segment documents the group id as required.
rules.fix_hint: Set `groupId` to the group in your database.

rules.message: An `alias` call carries no `previousId`. Segment documents the previous unique identifier as required.
rules.fix_hint: Set `previousId` to the id being merged.

params.name: userId
params.description: It is your own identifier for the user. Segment documents that a call needs either this or `anonymousId`.

params.name: anonymousId
params.description: It stands in for a user id when there is none. Segment documents that a call needs either this or `userId`.

params.name: timestamp
params.description: Segment documents the timestamp as an ISO 8601 date string. Leave it out for events happening now.
params.fix_hint: Send an ISO 8601 timestamp, or omit it and let Segment stamp the call.

params.name: sentAt
params.description: Segment documents `sentAt` as an ISO 8601 date string, the time the client sent the event.
params.fix_hint: Send an ISO 8601 timestamp, such as `2026-07-26T00:30:12.984Z`.

params.name: messageId
params.description: Segment deduplicates on `messageId` and documents fewer than 100 characters.
params.fix_hint: Send a unique `messageId` of at most 99 characters.

params.name: context.ip
params.description: It is the visitor IP, sent unhashed.

params.name: context.userAgent
params.description: It is the user agent of the device making the request. Segment documents it as unhashed on `context`.
params.fix_hint: Send the browser or device user agent string, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: context.page.url
params.description: It is the current page URL. Segment documents `url` on `context.page`.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute URL in `context.page.url`, including the scheme.

params.name: properties.currency
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of `properties.revenue`. Segment documents it as a reserved track property.
params.fix_hint: Send a three-letter code such as `USD`, or omit the field and Segment assumes US dollars.

params.name: properties.revenue
params.description: It is the dollar amount an event resulted in. Segment documents a reserved decimal number, such as `19.99`.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `19.99`, with no currency symbol.

params.name: properties.value
params.description: It is an abstract value for an event that does not generate dollar revenue. Segment documents a reserved number.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as `1`, with no unit suffix.

params.name: properties.url
params.description: It is the page's full URL. Segment documents `url` as a reserved page property.
params.fix_hint: Send an absolute URL in `properties.url`, including the scheme.

params.name: context.locale
params.description: It is the locale of the current user. Segment documents a string such as `en-US`.
params.fix_hint: Send a locale tag such as `en-US`, or omit the field.
